name: UK energy price cap
summary: Cap £1,723 a year; Cornwall Insight forecasts £1,999 for January, a 16% rise; Ofgem's January cap is due late November
state: Ofgem's cap for October to December 2026 is £1,723 a year for a typical dual-fuel household, a 4% rise on the previous quarter (Ofgem; Cornwall Insight). Cornwall Insight's forecast, calculated from prices on 28 Sep, puts the January to March 2027 cap at £1,999.28, about 16% higher and inside the 5–20% Watch band (Cornwall Insight). A higher supplier forecast of £2,165 from EDF in September has not been matched by Cornwall Insight, so the Alert line is not treated as crossed. Ofgem is due to announce the January cap in late November.
for_you: Households on default tariffs are likely to see bills rise from 1 January. Ofgem and Citizens Advice publish guidance on support for those struggling to pay energy bills.
rubric_hit: Forecast rise ~16% within 5–20% Watch band; cap £1,723 within £1,700–2,200
